reason: restore_block's only caller is take_off (render.6502:1303; kindcache only mentions it). SKY_MODE builds: sky_take_off returns C=1 only via .done (SEC), which BCS sky_off skips; the fall-through to JSR restore_block is reached only from .no (CLC), and LDA #0 between keeps C, so C=0 on entry. SKY_MODE=0 builds get an explicit CLC. With C=0, ADC #&F8 computes lo+&F8+0 = lo+~8+1 (what SBC #8 with C=1 computes): same A, same C (no borrow), same N/Z, and same V (operands &F7/&F8 both negative, same result). ADC #&FF with the carry is exactly SBC #0 (hi+~0+C): identical A and all flags. So rb_end/rb_end+1, A, X, Y, flags and stack are identical from the end of the replaced lines on; no labels or other entries inside the replaced lines (restore_block's label precedes STY rb_index, unchanged). D: code already relied on D=0 here (SBC/ADC); timer's SED is elsewhere. Interrupts see no different state (the IRQ saves P; no memory changes). Saves SEC: 2 cycles and 1 byte per execution in SKY_MODE builds; 0/0 in SKY_MODE=0 (CLC replaces SEC).
